<Subject 1> is Cloud Strife from <Picture 1>, with spiky pale-blond hair, turquoise eyes, a black sleeveless turtleneck sweater, black leather shoulder pauldron on his left shoulder, brown leather suspenders and belt, black baggy pants, brown leather boots, and the massive Buster Sword with a black-and-silver blade.
<Subject 2> is Sephiroth from <Picture 2>, with extremely long straight silver hair, narrow cold eyes, a long black leather coat with white shoulder pauldrons and a crossed black chest harness, black gloves, black boots, and the long noduchi Masamune with a blue-wrapped hilt.
<Subject 3> is the shared battlefield environment: a cracked dark-stone plateau under roiling purple-grey storm clouds, with crumbling Midgar-style ruin silhouettes on the horizon, wind-blown ash and debris.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a high-end 3D cinematic game-cutscene style with cold stormy lighting, high contrast, and volumetric wind-blown ash particles.
[Shot 1] Extreme close-up on <Subject 1>'s face: sharp turquoise eyes stare forward, spiky pale-blond hair whipping in the harsh wind. The camera slowly dollies backward and racks focus from his eyes to his hand gripping the hilt of the massive Buster Sword, the black-and-silver blade lowering to the cracked stone ground of <Subject 3>. Dust scuffs across the frame. <Subject 1> (S1) says in a low, determined young male voice, <d>[Japanese] 運命を、俺が終わらせる！</d> His jaw tightens and his grip on the hilt hardens.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, hard cut to an extreme close-up of <Subject 2>'s cold profile, a single strand of impossibly long silver hair drifting across his narrow pale eyes. The camera tracks laterally along his black leather shoulder pauldron, then tilts down to reveal his pale hand resting on the blue-wrapped hilt of Masamune. He slowly lifts the long noduchi until the blade points diagonally toward the stormy sky. <Subject 2> (S2) says in a deep, calm, elegant male voice with a faint mocking tone, <d>[Japanese] 来たか！</d> He closes his lips into a faint, dangerous smirk.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, rapid push-in close-up on <Subject 1>'s boots: he strides forward across the cracked stone, each step sending small stone fragments skittering, the Buster Sword resting on his right shoulder. Camera follows at boot level, then whips upward to his grim, resolute face.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, low-angle two-shot: <Subject 1> stands on the left with the Buster Sword raised, <Subject 2> stands on the right with Masamune lowered, ten meters apart on <Subject 3>. Wind blasts ash horizontally between them. Both figures hold a frozen combat stance, chests rising and falling, as the storm clouds churn overhead.
